integrity: The analytic proof treats every integer dimension at least three. Exact symbolic and finite tests are supplemental, not a substitute for infinite arguments.
scientific_limitations: Full strictly generic type-A normal fan only; ridges selected by uniform face count, not metric area; prior aggregate angle-sum theorem is credited. Possible unindexed prior equivalent remains; no independent external validation has been performed.
title: An exact type-A permutohedral ridge-angle law and its second-order Gaussian variance
